description: Potentiel solaire - Irradiation brute par surface utile (y compris couvert et parking) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Cette couche comprend les surfaces utiles où l'irradiation solaire brute annuelle dépasse 1000 kWh/m2.an. Elle est élaborée à l'échelle du Grand Genève qui englobe le Canton de Genève, le District de Nyon (Canton de Vaud) et plusieurs communautés de communes francaises des départements de l'Ain et de la Haute-Savoie. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 4 resource(s) in API, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
